review_scope: Independent static review only; no tests or heavy processes during quiet benchmark
verified_reasoning: Counting block IDs preserves ascending IDs and identical inverse mapping; sparse coordinate extents fall back to original unique/sort.
Histogram bins use unchanged quantization and ordered union across compared maps.
RNG initialization and per-draw integer sampling order are unchanged.
Source and each draw totals <=2**26 suffice for exact nonnegative float64 count products, cumulative sums and half-tie arithmetic. Larger cases retain historical column layout.
Return dictionary construction, rounding and validation preceding histogram construction are unchanged.
limits: Nonfinite maps are not validated by inherited quantizer. New bincount may change their exception type compared with historical add.at; valid-map equivalence should not be generalized to invalid maps.

Workspace is bounded linearly by pixel count, not by a fixed byte budget. Dense histograms already depend on occupied block count times1024; new bincount adds temporary integer histograms and pixel indices.
New pixel-oracle tests cover uint8,uint16 and three float scales, support zeros and margins; static review does not substitute for actual executed results.
suggested_optional_test: Finite unpaired other=None output equivalence and explicit documentation of inherited nonfinite invalid-input scope.
